# Alteryx System Settings App Errors

---

- Error in KB is from the Services app trying to start the Alteryx Service
- Alteryx Service Will Not Start - AlteryxService is Disabled (KB)

wide1800

- Entry Point Not Found. The procedure entry point k5 clear error could not be located in the dynamic link library (KB)

wide1800

- Error: "There is an error determining which application you are signing into. Return to the application and try again" when verifying IDP (KB)
- APODs are not Domain-Joined and therefore can’t use AD Auth.  Use Built-in for testing instead.

wide1800

- Ping SAML Alteryx System Settings: Unable to verify IDP. (KB)

wide1800

- Alteryx Server: Error: Current security context is not associated with an Active Directory domain or forest (KB)
